ModMetaData.name: HousekeeperAssistanceCat
ModMetaData.author: Edge Crescent
ModMetaData.description:
Continuation for HousekeeperAssistanceCat mod by Edge Crescent. While using the same assets, background logic for cleaning tasks is fully reworked.
This mod adds a new kind of animal - Housekeeper Cat. When Obedience is trained, they are able to do cleaning tasks. They are also eligible for hauling training. As a bonus, they can produce small amounts of quality wool.
On 1.7 the cats clean first and haul second, and they clean the rooms where cleanliness matters (kitchens, hospitals, bedrooms...) before the rest. That needs Important Clean (e71).
Supports Pawnmorpher partial morphs!
